summary: Harney County, OR 50-foot wooden-platform tower built in the 1930s; reported closed to the public because of wildlife in 2024; no staff or fire history found.

facts.status_note: Last described standing on an April 2024 visit; no later report of its condition. An August 2026 OPB article says fires took at least two unnamed 1930s historical structures on and around the refuge, without saying whether this tower was one

access.note: Reported closed to the public because of wildlife (April 2024 visit); no reopening date given

visit.trail_note: The 2024 visitor suggested viewing it from Highway 205. Stay out of the closed area.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three secondary web pages, a 1995 archaeology citation and a 2024 blog visit. No staffing, fire or construction-date detail was found; the built date is decade-only. Status 'standing' rests on the April 2024 visit. The August 2026 OPB article names no structures, so it does not confirm or rule out loss of this tower. Two web searches and the source pages surfaced no staffing or fire history.
